name: reading-time
title: Reading Time
description: A compact "N min read" badge for article headers, blog cards and docs index rows. It renders an inline `<span>`, so it sits beside a date or a tag row without imposing block layout.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/reading-time

Installed to `components/ui/reading-time.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/reading-time';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/reading-time

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
